```text
backdown swarm [OPTIONS] [COMMAND]
```

## Options

`--cached`
: Don't ask the other machines now: show them as last synced.

`--json`
: Print it as JSON.

## backdown swarm where {#where}

Find files and folders by name on every machine: which machine, which drive, where.

```text
backdown swarm where [OPTIONS] <NAME>...
```

### Arguments

`<NAME>...`
: Words in the name (all of them must be in it).

### Options

`--limit <LIMIT>`
: List this many at most. Default: `50`.

`--cached`
: Don't ask the other machines now: search what was last synced of them.

`--json`
: Print them as JSON.

All of them also take the [global options](/docs/cli/#global-options) `--db` and `--local`.
